summary: Swarmer Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with Lucid Capital Markets. This is an equity-line facility allowing Swarmer to sell up to 3,000,000 shares at its discretion over 24 months, subject to an exchange cap and a minimum $1.00 price. No specific sale is triggered; it is a standby facility, not a special-situation corporate event. Given the routine nature of this at-the-market facility, no further special-situation analysis is warranted. The filing does not involve a change of control, restructuring, or shareholder return.
